d: Room in the castle of Rotherwood. Table in the middle in the form of T. In the top of it, two chairs distinct for 'l Thane, and for his daughter. Seats to both parts of the table, on which Saxon Knights. A butler, and two Couples at the top. Domestic Paggi in service. Two large windows in the bottom. Two large side doors. The banquet is at the end. Lightnings happen. The Convitati sing joyfully in choir.
The Menestrello appears.
Two bridesmaids precede Editta, who advances staring with interest at the Menestrello.
Cedric, from the door to the right. Two Paggi follow him: and the previous ones.
The Menestrello.

A remote part in the castle. On the left there is a porch, with various doors, which is the home of the castle. On the right there is a fence, adjacent to a ruinous temple, closed by a gate, shaded by willows and cypresses, where are the tombs of the family of Rotherwood. Stone benches around. Rebecca from the porch.
Editta and Rebecca.
Rebecca, lead the Menestrello.

Piazzale del castello. In perspective the walls. Get in the middle: two side towers. The one on the right is recently destroyed by lightning, and from whose ruins you can see the countryside. The palace of Cedric on the left. To the right buildings. Beyond the walls hills, mountains: castles on them, villages. Odesi a horn sound beyond the walls. Across Knights from various sides. Some rise on the parapets. Others face the wounds. One mounts on the tower of the door: they speak to each other, and they respond in

On the bridge Briano presents himself in a simple dress of armored herald. The Scudieri introduce him: he advances alteredly, he observes with marked attention to the surroundings: he then turns to Cedric.
Rebecca's anxiety bows down to Cedric. Editta and Dame seco. Ishmael.
Ivanhoe from the palace climbs over Briano, pulling Rebecca back with force.

Gothic arch on the highest floor of a tower in Sir Edmondo's castle. Wide window that puts to the platform, without parapet, that surrounds the top of the tower. Side rooms. Rebecca frantic, looks around, opens the window, measures with a look at the height: chills.
Briano, as a temple knight, and the precedents.
Briano and Alberto.

Alpestrian rocks join together for various wooden bridges. The castle of Rotherwood set on fire at some distance. Several repeated horn sounds, which each of them respond, and are approaching and joining together. We see groups of Montanari, led by their leaders, who then come and alternate in choir.
Cedric, on the one hand, with various Saxons. Indi Ivanhoe with other Saxons, and the precedents.

Room of the Knights, in the castle of St. Edemondo. Chair in the middle. Seats for the Knights, guards at the gates. Out come two Heralds: ind Guards. Then Knights. Alberto with Briano: Scudieri, Paggi.

Exterior of the castle of St. Edemondo. The abbey is on the top, in the form of a fortress. Adjacent temple. It descends tortuously from the abbey to the castle gate, and from the drawbridge you pass to the plain. On the left the barriers of the camp for two knights. A stake guarded by two armed Negroes. Manufactured for vassals of the abbey. Bosco. The great bell of the abbey announces with slow sounds the hour of the judgment of God. People who run. Dame, Donzelle, Knights. From the abbey door appear two Heralds. Indi Soldati. The Knights then followed by 'Scudieri. The Guards among whom is led Rebecca, dressed with simple white tonaca. Editta is next to her. Alberto and Briano 'their Scudieri. One of these, on the tip of the spear, carries the cheek of Rebecca. A Cavaliere ahead of them. Pajori and explained Pajoriè Flaming
Ivanhoe from the Lunge. Cedric with Saxons. Shields with spear and shield of Ivanhoe.
Cedric, some Saxons: then Ishmael.

The Giulivo people from the camp. Guards, Knights, Scudieri, Ivanhoe, preceded by his Scudiero, who carries on the spear the helmet and shield of Briano. Rebecca with Editta, and followed by Dame and Donzelle. Soldiers. Sings festively in choir.
